context: BACKGROUND Ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) has been linked to emergency department (ED) intubation and length of stay (LOS). We assessed VAP prevalence in ED intubated patients, feasibility of ED VAP prevention, and effect on VAP rates. METHODS This was a quality improvement initiative using a pre/post design.
target: Phase 1 (PRE1) comprised patients before intensive care unit (ICU) bundle deployment.
